prompt:
Locked-off camera, no zoom, no pan. The red-haired lad in the grey hoodie stands beside the tall black server cabinet on the right of frame, his phone held against his chest in his left hand, his right hand at the small socket on the side of the cabinet holding the white cable plug. He is already looking back over his right shoulder toward the counters. He pushes the plug firmly into the socket, his eyes still darting back across the hall to check nobody saw. Holding that look for a beat, he then turns his head back to the cabinet, glances down at the plug, and a tiny, satisfied smile creeps onto his face, mouth closed. The cabinet's green and blue lights keep blinking. The people at the distant counters stay where they are, going about their business. The POWER signs keep their exact letters. Same three-quarter view of him, same light throughout.
Natural documentary realism, overcast daylight.
Thanks.
